title: Re:XrayAndSuperTools(X光与超级工具：重生)
description: This is a mod with overpowered equipment and tools, or rather, a "salty fish" mod. It is inspired by the classic old mod Super Tools.(这是一个带有超模装备与工具的模组，或者说咸鱼模组。灵感来自经典老模组Super Tools。)
body:
This mod introduces a variety of powerful blocks, including X-ray Blocks, Super Ore, Deepslate Super Ore, and furnaces such as the X-ray Furnace and Super Furnace. Among them, the X-ray Block, Super X-ray Block, X-ray Furnace, and Super X-ray Furnace are capable of x-ray vision.

The X-ray Furnace smelts items 16 times faster than a regular furnace, without consuming extra fuel. This means you can process 16 times the usual amount of items with a single piece of fuel, all at an incredibly high speed.

The mod also adds a set of powerful equipment, including the X-ray Trident, Mace, and Spear. To fully utilize the armor’s defensive potential, you’ll need to install the AttributeFix mod to remove the armor cap. Additionally, the Spear Core mod is required to use spears.

There are some benign bugs present, such as the Trident’s ranged damage being abnormally doubled, which the author has no plans to fix.

Finally, we hope you enjoy the mod and have a great time!

本模组添加了许多功能强大的方块，例如 X 光块、超级矿石、深层超级矿石等矿物，以及 X 光熔炉、超级熔炉等熔炉。其中，X 光块、超级 X 光块、X 光熔炉和超级 X 光熔炉具有透视能力。

X 光熔炉的熔炼速度是普通熔炉的 16 倍，且燃料消耗速度不变——这意味着您只需消耗 1 份燃料，即可烧制原本需要 16 份燃料才能完成的工作量，同时熔炼速度极快。

此外，本模组还新增了一系列强力装备，包括 X 光三叉戟、重锤、长矛等。为了充分发挥本模组盔甲的全部防御潜力，您需要安装《属性修复》（AttributeFix）模组以移除护甲值上限；若要使用长矛，则必须安装《长矛核心》（Spear Core）模组。

目前，模组中存在一些良性 bug（例如三叉戟的远程伤害会异常翻倍），作者并不打算修复它们。

最后，祝各位玩家游戏愉快！
